label: Claude Chat Composer
description: Claude AI chat interface with multi-line composer box, two-level tools/connectors menu, and animated UI walkthrough. Supports scripted cursor interactions: click plus, open category menu, hover connectors, show submenu, toggle items. SCRIPTED: pass the full interaction sequence in data.script (see the script field) -- the component performs it itself; embedding it static and animating over it is wrong.

menu_items.label: Connector Items (shown in connectors submenu, all OFF by default)

script.label: Scripted timeline: [{"action": "...", "at": seconds, ...}]. Actions: type {text}, click, hover-plus / unhover-plus, open-menu / close-menu, hover-connectors, show-connectors, toggle-item {target}, show-typing, show-response {text}, plus base actions move-cursor, highlight, zoom-to, wait, parallel. Drive the whole interaction through this script.

cursor_targets.label: Named cursor positions for move-cursor/click in 0-1 component coords.

script_actions.description: Type text into the multi-line composer input area
Click the send button or plus button
Open the primary + menu showing categories: Add files, Skills, Connectors, Research, Web search, etc.
Highlight the Connectors row in the primary + menu (typically before show-connectors)
Slide open the connectors submenu to the right of the primary menu, showing toggle switches for each connector (all OFF by default)
Close both the primary menu and connectors submenu
Toggle a connector's switch on or off in the submenu

params.index: number - Zero-based index of the connector to toggle
params.target: string - Connector name or id (alternative to index)

script_actions.description: Show typing indicator with bouncing dots

params.duration: number - How long to show typing (default 1.5s)
